LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING). 11.1.1 CONVERSATION SKILLS: JOB INTERVIEWS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.1: Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking). 11.1.1 Conversation Skills: Job Interviews
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking). 11.1.1 Conversation Skills: Job Interviews, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you succeed in a job interview? 2. Why is it important to prepare for a job interview?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking). 11.1.1 Conversation Skills: Job Interviews together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: effective communication when the learner communicates effectively by asking and answering questions in a

mock interview.

134

● Collaboration: teamwork skills when the learners work together to review an interview and role play an interview session.

Values:
Learner support programme-Integrity: the learners appreciate that getting a job depends on preparedness for an interview,

excellent interview skills and providing truthful information.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate interview skills to interviewing as a method of correcting information in Social Studies.
